notes: GST is 3% on gold and silver jewellery on the total transaction value (making charges included) and 3% IGST on imports of precious metals (GST Council FAQ). Import duty nulled in round 4: the 15% figure (10% BCD + 5% AIDC from 13 May 2026) was readable only as a reproduction on a tax-professional site; the notification itself would not open on cbic.gov.in, so it is omitted.

sources.name: GST Council / CBEC - Sectoral FAQ: Gems & Jewellery
sources.what: Q7: GST is payable at 3% of the total transaction value of gold, diamond or silver jewellery, whether the making charge is shown separately or not. Q2 and Q4: 3% IGST is payable on all imports of precious metals and GST is payable at 3% - so gold and silver, bullion and jewellery, all take 3%.
